ad_library.summary: Hysun Solar Pvt Ltd is live on both paid channels - one Google ad behind a verified account and Meta ads selling the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy to Hyderabad homeowners. The split is the story: the Google click reaches hysunsolar.com, while every Meta click is captured inside a WhatsApp chat or a Facebook lead form. The site itself could not be read on 2026-11-14 - it returned HTTP 500 on every path - and the pages that are indexed publish an Ahmedabad address under ads that say Bandlaguda Jagir, Hyderabad. They also already run a service app with one-tap maintenance requests that no ad mentions.
